newsitem.title: USA: General Employment to open 8 units in 1997.
newsitem.headline: General Employment to open 8 units in 1997.

text.p: General Employment Enterprises Inc, which operates 31 employment offices in 12 states, said Wednesday it plans to open an additional eight new offices during fiscal 1997.
General Employment opened six offices during fiscal 1996.

Earlier today, the company reported earnings for its fiscal 1997 first quarter ended December 31, 1996 rose 35 percent from the same period last year to $424,000 or $0.16 a share. Fiscal first quarter revenues of $5.9 million were 18 percent higher than its first quarter a year ago.
Earnings and revenues rose due to ongoing demand for information technology personnel for temporary contract assignments and for regular full-time staff people, it said.

The first two openings of fiscal 1997 were slated for Dallas, Texas and the Newark/Fremont, California area. In February, an office will open in the mid-town Manhattan, New York City area and the company will add a second office in suburban Boston, in Reading, Massachusetts.
Shares of General Employment were trading off 1/8 to 10.
